g.text: Bounded RL vs controls (all from the dev-selected M1 checkpoint; sel = best 6 of 32 by reward, xSFT = extra SFT, fSFT = reward-filtered SFT) — mean over seeds [0, 1, 2], group-bootstrap 95 % CI — FINAL held-out set (locked; one pass per frozen method)
